name: The Breaking (v1)
premise: The settlement's resistance shows as a ring around it, thick where belief runs deep.
loop: Strike the ring where it is thinnest; each strike hardens the arcs beside it. Find the collapsing sequence before your stamina runs out.
signals: Arc strength reads as the ring's thickness and glow; a struck arc cracks; hardened arcs brighten.
outcome_win: The ring collapses and the settlement lies open.
outcome_fail: Stamina spent, the ring reseals thicker than before.
why_fun: A sequencing puzzle wearing an action skin — reading the structure matters more than hitting it.
